items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: Tets used to play with us too, Tets, Alexander.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, Tets used to play with us too, Tets, Alexander. He was a wonderful, my sister. And this other boy, they'd come down there working with Sidney, and they stayed there in town, Boots and his brother, you know, used to work in them Jitney's house. Austin and Thorpe. Spoke and his brother. Spoke with the Saxon and Boots was his base pair. Yeah, young. Yeah, young. Well they're not from here, huh? They're from Nashville.
